scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:publish: npm run build && npm run dist:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
scripts.dist:stable: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs stable && node scripts/build-channel-config.mjs stable && node scripts/ensure-draft-release.mjs stable && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always --config electron-builder.stable.generated.json
scripts.dist:staging: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs staging && node scripts/build-channel-config.mjs staging && node scripts/ensure-draft-release.mjs staging && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always --config electron-builder.staging.generated.json
